@menu.file.content_folders: Item of the File menu that opens the choice of folders the object menu and the road menu read (ADR 084)
menu.file.content_folders.tooltip: Choose which folders of Sceneryobjects and Splines the object menu and the road menu read
contentfolders.title: Object and spline folders
contentfolders.description: Untick the folders the object menu and the road menu should leave out. MapWorks then does not read them at all, which keeps the menus quick with many add-ons and a lot of community content. What the map already uses is still drawn and stays in the In map tabs. The choice is kept on this computer, for this OMSI installation.
contentfolders.all.tooltip: Tick every folder of this list
contentfolders.none.tooltip: Untick every folder of this list
contentfolders.own: Mapforge holds a folder for each project with the junctions, road types and objects MapWorks made for it. You can leave out those of other projects; the one of the open project always stays in.
contentfolders.status.no_map: Open a map first: the folders belong to the OMSI installation of the map.
contentfolders.status.list_failed: The folders of the installation could not be listed: {reason}
contentfolders.status.unchanged: The folders stay as they are.
contentfolders.status.applied: {objects, plural, =0 {All object folders are read} one {# object folder is left out} other {# object folders are left out}}, {splines, plural, =0 {all spline folders are read} one {# spline folder is left out} other {# spline folders are left out}}. The menus are read again.
contentfolders.status.failed: The menus follow the new choice, but it could not be kept for the next start: {reason}
contentfolders.this_project.tooltip: The folder of the open project stays in: MapWorks puts the junctions and road types it makes for this project there.
